check_usage.description: How much browser time and proxy traffic a project has used. Put it on a schedule to catch a runaway script before the bill does.
check_usage.name: check_usage

parameters.description: Leave empty if the account has only one project, which most do. Pick one when there are several.
parameters.name: project

close_browser.description: Ask a browser session to finish, so it stops costing browser time instead of running until it times out. Use it on a browser that 'List browser sessions' shows still open.
close_browser.name: close_browser

parameters.description: The session's id, as given back by 'List browser sessions' or by a finished task.
parameters.name: session_id

expires_at.description: When it will close on its own.

is_running.description: True while the browser is still open and being charged for.

keep_alive.description: True when it stays open after the code disconnects.

proxy_bytes.description: Bytes it sent through the proxies.

region.description: Where in the world it is running.

create_agent.description: Save a set of standing instructions that browsing tasks can run under, so the same rules do not have to be repeated in every task. Use it for the things that are always true of a site: where to sign in, what to avoid, what a good answer looks like.

mock_response.instructions: Always download the PDF invoice rather than the summary page.
mock_response.name: Supplier portal

create_agent.name: create_agent

parameters.description: What to call this agent, so you can recognise it later, such as 'Supplier portal'.
parameters.name: name

parameters.description: What every task run under this agent should always do, such as 'Always download the PDF invoice rather than the summary page'.
parameters.name: instructions

parameters.description: Name each thing the answer should carry and say what it is, for example 'price' and 'The total including delivery'. Leave it empty and the answer comes back as written text.
parameters.name: answer_shape

answer_shape.description: The shape its answers come back in, if one was set.

instructions.description: The standing instructions every task using it follows.

delete_agent.description: Permanently delete a saved agent. Tasks that already ran under it keep their results, and deleting an agent that has already gone does nothing.
delete_agent.name: delete_agent

parameters.description: Pick a saved agent. An agent made by an earlier step in this workflow is not in the list yet, so use its id from that step instead.
parameters.name: agent_id

deleted.description: Always true once the delete went through.

extract_from_page.description: Fetch a page and pick named details out of it, so a later step gets tidy fields instead of a wall of text. Name what you want and Browserbase reads the page for it. It does not run the page's scripts and cannot read a PDF this way, so use 'Start a browsing task' for either.
extract_from_page.display_name: Pull details out of a web page
extract_from_page.display_str_template: Pull details out of {0} with Browserbase.
extract_from_page.name: extract_from_page

parameters.description: The address of the page to read, starting with https://.

parameters.description: Name each detail and say what it is, for example 'price' and 'The price of the cheapest plan'. Each one comes back under the name you gave it.
parameters.name: details

extract_from_page.result_str_template: Pulled the details out of the page.

details.description: The details found, under the names you gave.

is_ok.description: True when the site answered normally.

status_code.description: What the site answered with, such as 200 or 404.

get_task.description: Read a task back. While it is still working this says how far it has got; once it has finished it carries what the browser found. Check 'is_finished' to know which you have.

session_id.description: The browser session behind the task.

task.description: What the browser was asked to do.

get_task_steps.description: Read back the steps a task took, in order: the pages it opened, what it clicked and what it said along the way. Use it when a task did not come back with what you expected.

total_step_count.description: How many steps the task took in total.

read_page.description: Fetch a page through Browserbase and bring back what it says, as readable text or as its HTML. The request carries a real browser's fingerprint, so a site that turns away a plain request will often answer this one. The page is fetched rather than opened, so for a page that only fills itself in once its scripts have run, use 'Start a browsing task' instead.
read_page.name: read_page

parameters.description: The address of the page to read, starting with https://.
parameters.name: url

parameters.description: Readable text is right for almost everything: it is the page with the menus and markup stripped out. Browserbase charges the conversion at a higher rate than a plain fetch, so choose the HTML when a later step wants the markup anyway.
parameters.name: format

options.label: Readable text, ready for a later step
The page's HTML, exactly as it was sent

parameters.description: Keep going when the address forwards somewhere else. Turn this off to see the forwarding response itself.
parameters.name: follow_redirects

content.description: The page, as text or as HTML.

content_type.description: What kind of thing the page is.

is_ok.description: True when the site answered normally.

status_code.description: What the site answered with, such as 200 or 404.

search_web.description: Search the web and get back ranked results with their titles, addresses and publication dates. Pair it with 'Read a web page' to read the ones worth reading.
search_web.display_str_template: Search the web for '{0}' with Browserbase.

parameters.description: What to search for, in plain language, up to 200 characters.

start_task.description: Describe a job in plain language and a cloud browser does it: searching, opening pages, clicking, typing and reading. The browser works in the background, so this step hands back a task id straight away. Follow it with a Wait step and 'Check a browsing task' to collect what it found.

mock_response.task: Find the starting price on the Browserbase pricing page.

start_task.name: start_task
